tag: Foot-PoseNet · 23 Keypoints · Edge TPU · Physical Therapy
title: FootPoseNet: Multi-Person Pose Estimation for Knee Injury Rehabilitation
description: A modified PersonLab deep convolutional architecture trained for bottom-up multi-person pose estimation, predicting heatmaps and offsets for 23 anatomical keypoints (17 standard body joints plus 6 specialized feet keypoints). Optimized for low-latency edge inference on Google Coral TPU USB Accelerator at 20 FPS, refined with Median, Savitzky-Golay and Chebyshev temporal filters to eliminate kinematic jitter, reducing knee angle root-mean-square error (RMSE) by 10.7% during physical rehabilitation exercises.

media.alt: FootPoseNet pose estimation and knee joint angle tracking demonstration

tag: Computer Vision · CNNs · Eye Gaze Tracking
title: Eye Gaze Direction Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks on Low-Resolution Cameras
description: A deep learning framework answering how to effectively recognize eye gaze direction by maximizing performance while reducing hardware costs. Developed ESGDset (156,000 images under diverse illumination, head postures, and scenarios) and GDNet, a two-phase architecture that segments candidate eye regions before classification, achieving 98.32% accuracy with an error rate of 0.087 on low-resolution cameras.

media.alt: Eye Gaze Direction Recognition system with candidate eye segmentation and 3D gaze vector estimation
